title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of October, November, and December 1988. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation is based on the respective cost of buring coal and oil.
